description: This file declares the interface for a keyword set library, including data structures, functions for creating, extending, preparing, executing searches, and freeing keyword sets.

methods.name: kwsalloc
methods.description: Allocates a new keyword set with optional character translation table.

methods.name: kwsincr
methods.description: Adds a new keyword to the existing keyword set.

methods.name: kwsprep
methods.description: Finalizes the keyword set for use after all keywords have been added.

methods.name: kwsexec
methods.description: Searches within a buffer for a match from the keyword set.

methods.name: kwsfree
methods.description: Deallocates the keyword set and its associated resources.

ctags.name: index
ctags.pattern: /^  int index;			\/* Index number of matching keyword. *\/$/

ctags.name: offset
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t offset[1];		\/* Offset of each submatch. *\/$/

ctags.name: size
ctags.pattern: /^  size_t size[1];		\/* Length of each submatch. *\/$/
